_help: Elite Dangerous general knowledge (personality/knowledge.py). Only things that are stable across updates.

entries.a: The centre of the galaxy is a supermassive black hole called Sagittarius A star. In Elite it sits about twenty five thousand nine hundred light years from Sol.
Sagittarius A star is about twenty five thousand nine hundred light years from Sol.
Beagle Point is the famous far edge of the galaxy, about sixty five thousand light years from Sol. Explorers go there to say they went.
Colonia is a cluster of systems about twenty two thousand light years from Sol, founded by the Colonia Council. It's a popular stop for explorers.
The Elite galaxy is a full scale model of the Milky Way, with around four hundred billion star systems.
Sol is our home system, and the Federation's capital. Earth is the third planet.
The Empire's capital is Achenar.
The Alliance's capital is Alioth.
There are three major powers: the Federation, the Empire and the Alliance, plus the independents.
Frontier Developments makes Elite Dangerous. The original Elite in 1984 was by David Braben and Ian Bell.
Elite Dangerous was released in December 2014.
The original Elite came out in 1984, by David Braben and Ian Bell. It had a whole galaxy in about twenty two kilobytes.
Fly into the jet cone of a neutron star in supercruise and your next hyperspace jump can go up to four times its normal range. Line up, stay in the cone, and watch the temperature.
A white dwarf's jet cone gives your next jump one and a half times its normal range.
You can fuel scoop from O, B, A, F, G, K and M class stars. Remember the line, Oh Be A Fine Guy Kiss Me. Neutron stars, white dwarfs and black holes are not scoopable.
The honk is the discovery scanner pulse. It reveals what's in a system so you can see what's worth scanning.
Exploration ranks run Aimless, Mostly Aimless, Scout, Surveyor, Trailblazer, Pathfinder, Ranger, Pioneer and finally Elite.
Combat ranks run Harmless, Mostly Harmless, Novice, Competent, Expert, Master, Dangerous, Deadly and Elite.
Trade ranks run Penniless, Mostly Penniless, Peddler, Dealer, Merchant, Broker, Entrepreneur, Tycoon and Elite.
The Thargoids are a hostile insectoid alien species. Treat their ships very respectfully.
The Guardians are an ancient, vanished alien civilisation. Their ruins and technology are scattered through the galaxy.
A fleet carrier is a huge player owned ship that can jump across the galaxy and act as a mobile base. It costs a lot to run.
A fleet carrier can jump up to five hundred light years at a time.
Supercruise is the in-system travel mode that lets you cross a system at many times the speed of light. Hyperspace is for jumping between systems.
The frame shift drive is your ship's hyperspace engine. It's what lets you jump between star systems and fly in supercruise.
Powerplay lets you pledge to one of the superpowers' leaders, and spread their influence by completing work in the galaxy.
Exobiology means finding, scanning and sampling alien plants and life on planets. Each species sold to Universal Cartographics earns a bonus.
The codex is your in-game encyclopedia of everything you have discovered.
Engineers are specialists who can upgrade your ship's modules with blueprints and experimental effects, if you gather the materials and earn their trust.
CMDR is short for Commander, which is what you are.
Landing pads come in three sizes: small, medium and large. Your ship must fit one of them.
A heat sink launcher ejects a canister that soaks up your ship's heat. It's useful when you need to go quiet or cool off.
Silent running stops your ship's heat leaking out to sensors, but your heat builds up. It's useful for hiding, not for long.
Hardpoints are the mounts for your weapons. Deploy them before a fight and retract them to save heat and speed.
The SRV is your planetary buggy, launched from your ship to drive on surfaces. The Scarab is the standard one.
A wing is a group of up to four commanders flying together.
A bounty is a price on a pilot's head. Bounty hunting means killing wanted pilots and handing in the vouchers for credits.
Mining means breaking up asteroids in a ring, for example with a mining laser or by prospecting, and collecting the metals and minerals to sell.
Platinum is a precious metal that you mine in rings, and it's one of the better earners. I can tell you where the nearest buyer is if you ask.
Painite is a rare mineral you find in metallic rings, and one of the most valuable things you can mine.
